control.authorization: decoded PRIVATE_APP, local API or INTERNAL, from=0, getFrom=self, to=self, not MQTT, want_ack=false, pki_encrypted=false, want_response=true
control.config: exact matching prepared run; firmware accepts only complete with no pending TX
control.effects: read-only snapshot; no DATA, STOP, RX rearm, TX cancellation, FIFO clear, or persistent configuration write

reply.identity: local self PRIVATE_APP reply; request_id matches the control packet ID; header run/source/destination match the request config
reply.response_match: raw MeshPacket must have portnum=PRIVATE_APP, transport_mechanism=TRANSPORT_INTERNAL (0) or TRANSPORT_API (7), want_ack=false, pki_encrypted=false, and via_mqtt=false
reply.metric: count=0 requires min=max=sum=0; otherwise min<=max<=600000000, count*min<=sum, sum>=max, and unsaturated sum<=count*max
reply.counter_scope: saturating board-local counters reset with benchmark RESET; RX valid_done counts completions and can overlap rx_invalid when one callback has an arm failure; TX classifications are diagnostic and have no invented conservation equation
reply.default_off: when available=0, all metric values, counters, and overflow are zero; source_kind remains OWNER_NOTIFY
reply.host_bounds: only correlated responses within the finite request deadline are evidence; stale, malformed, foreign, and parser/reader/write failures invalidate capture
reply.interpretation: owner_rx_notify_to_rearm_us excludes IRQ notification latency; owner_tx_notify_to_start_transmit_call_us excludes RadioLib startTransmit staging; neither establishes RF delivery, guard margin, collision safety, throughput, PER, or recovery authorization
